Name: Slime Hutch Auto Water - Automatic Slime Trough Filling
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[size=5][b][center]Slime Hutch Auto-Water[/center][/b][/size][center]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?sortBy=endorsements&%3BgameId=1303&gameId=1303][size=3]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?sortBy=endorsements&%3BgameId=1303&gameId=1303[/size]

Never lift a watering can in your Slime Hutch again and keep your slimes producing slime balls every single day without the manual labor.

Tired of walking all the way to your Slime Hutch just to click four times? This mod handles the morning chores for you. It automatically detects every water trough in every Slime Hutch on your farm and fills them to the brim the moment you wake up.

[center]﻿[youtube]hkIKSoLUiLM[/youtube][/center]

[b]Features
[/b]
[list]
[*]Automatically fills all water spots in every Slime Hutch daily.
[/list][list]
[*]Works with multiple Slime Hutches and modded farm layouts.
[/list][list]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) support to toggle the mod on or off in-game.
[/list][list]
[*]Lightweight and performance-friendly code for Stardew Valley 1.6.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41618/41618-1769318503-741124906.png[/img]﻿[b]Installation
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it.
[*]Place the [i]SlimeHutchAutoWater[/i] folder into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.﻿
[/list]
[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41618/41618-1769318503-1105306656.png[/img]﻿[/center][b]Technical Details
[/b]
This mod uses the Stardew Valley 1.6 Utility functions to ensure it finds Slime Hutches regardless of where they are placed. It triggers at the start of the day, so your slimes will always have water before you even leave the farmhouse.

[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI - Stardew Modding API
Generic Mod Config Menu (Optional, but recommended for easy settings)
